today.title: Today
today.error: Today's numbers couldn't be loaded. They'll retry shortly.

endOfDay.title: How today went
endOfDay.empty: Nobody has been served yet today. The summary appears after the first guest is served.

rightNow.title: Right now
rightNow.error: The line couldn't be loaded. It will retry shortly.

addLocation.title: Add a location
addLocation.intro: Each location has its own queues, hours, team and join page.
addLocation.adminsOnly: Only admins and owners can add a location.
addLocation.nameHint: Shown to your team and your customers, for example "Elm Street".
addLocation.tzHint: The location's own time zone, used for opening hours and the start of each day.
addLocation.slugHint: Optional. Leave blank to build it from the name. It is printed on QR posters, so it can't be changed later.

errors.invalid_timezone: Pick a time zone from the list.
errors.invalid_input: Check the details: use a name of 120 characters or fewer and a web address of lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
errors.slug_taken: That join page address is already used. Try another, or leave it blank.
errors.permission_denied: Only admins and owners can add a location.
errors.unknown: Couldn't add the location. Check your connection and try again.

location.title: Location settings
location.readOnly: Only admins and owners can change these settings.
location.name: Location name
location.slugHint: Printed on your QR posters, so it never changes.
location.contactHint: A phone number or email shown on the join page.
location.countryHint: Customers' phone numbers default to this country's dialling code.
location.countryNotSet: Not set (use each customer's phone settings)
location.dayBoundaryHint: Ticket numbers reset at this local time. Pick a time after you close, such as 04:00.
location.displayNames: Show customers' names on the waiting-room screen
location.displayNamesHint: Off by default. When off, the screen shows ticket numbers only.
location.onsiteCode: Require the code on the waiting-room screen to join online
location.onsiteCodeHint: Guests who join from their phone must type the 4-digit code shown on your screen, so people who aren't in the room can't join. Kiosk and staff-added guests never need it. Printed QR codes keep working.
location.onsiteCodeMinutesHint: 2 to 60. The screen shows a countdown; a code stays valid for one more change after it is replaced.
location.displayNamesWarning: Everyone in the room, and anyone looking through the window, will see the name each customer gives. Only turn this on if your customers expect it.
location.printFooterHint: Optional line printed at the bottom of paper tickets.

announce.title: Call announcements
announce.hint: The waiting-room display speaks each call in these languages, in this order. Voices are the ones on this device; a display without a chosen voice uses its own.

location.positionHint: Used only by queues that ask guests to be nearby. Leave blank to switch it off.
location.positionDenied: We couldn't get your position. Type the latitude and longitude instead.
location.positionInvalid: Enter both a latitude (-90 to 90) and a longitude (-180 to 180), or clear both.

errors.invalid_timezone: Pick a time zone from the list.
errors.permission_denied: Only admins and owners can change these settings.
errors.unknown: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalid_input: Check the details: a staff resource needs a member of this location, and a table needs seats.
errors.display_names_locked: Names can't be shown on screens for this business. Waiting guests appear by ticket number only.
errors.keyword_taken: Another queue already uses that text-to-join word.
errors.keyword_invalid: That text-to-join word is reserved or not allowed.

queues.title: Queues
queues.readOnly: Only managers, admins and owners can change queues.
queues.emptyHint: Add a queue so customers can join.
queues.name: Queue name
queues.prefixHint: One to three letters. Tickets read {{prefix}}001, {{prefix}}002 and so on.
queues.prefixInvalid: Use one to three letters, A to Z.
queues.capacityHint: Leave empty for no limit. When full, new customers can't join.
queues.joinRateHint: Stops a flood of fake joins. 60 suits most places.
queues.onlineJoinsPerHourHint: After this many, customers are sent to the front desk until the hour rolls over. 120 suits most places.
queues.partySize: Ask how many people are in the party
queues.partySizeHint: Customers pick a number on the join page. When off, every visit counts as one person.
queues.autoNoShowHint: A called customer who hasn't come when the grace period ends is marked a no-show. They get a warning message first, and you can undo it.
queues.warningSeconds: Warn them this many seconds before
queues.warningSecondsHint: At least 20, and shorter than the grace period.
queues.servingReminderHint: Minutes into service before staff are nudged. At least 15. Leave blank to let the system decide.

policyProblem.partyRange: The smallest party must be at least 1, no larger than the largest, and the largest at most 50.
policyProblem.warning: The warning must come at least 20 seconds before the grace period ends.
policyProblem.warningVsGrace: The warning must be shorter than the grace period.
policyProblem.reminder: The service reminder must be at least 15 minutes, or blank.
policyProblem.threshold: Almost up must be between 1 and 20 places.
policyProblem.joinLater: Joining later can look ahead 1 to 12 hours.

queues.showEtaHint: When off, customers see their place in line only.
queues.archiveDescription: Customers can no longer join it, and it leaves this list. Its history is kept.

alerts.title: Guest alerts
alerts.intro: Pick the messages guests of this queue can get. Guests can switch off any of these but cannot add others. Wording is edited under Templates.
alerts.joinedHint: Sends a message as soon as someone joins. Email goes only to addresses staff added; an email a guest typed is not used until it is verified, so this reaches guests through push.
alerts.thresholdHint: Guests within this many places of the front are told they are almost up (1 to 20).

trigger.no_show_warning: Place about to be given away

assignmentHint.none: Guests wait for whichever counter calls next.
assignmentHint.round_robin: Each new guest is given the next working counter in turn. Any counter can still call anyone.
assignmentHint.least_busy: Each new guest is given the working counter with the fewest guests assigned. Any counter can still call anyone.

restrictionOption.onsite_code: Only people who can see the screen (on-site code)
restrictionOption.geofence: Only people near the location (shared position)

restrictionHint.onsite_code: Guests type the code shown on your display. This is the check that is hard to fake.
restrictionHint.geofence: Guests share their position once. Browsers can be made to report a false position, so use the on-site code if that matters. Set the location's position first (Location page).

queues.joinLater: Let guests join for later today
queues.joinLaterHint: Guests pick an arrival time. They get a ticket now and enter the line at that time.
queues.smsKeywordHint: Optional. Guests text this word to your business number to join. 2 to 20 letters or digits.

smsKeywordProblem.format: Use 2 to 20 letters or digits, with no spaces.
smsKeywordProblem.reserved: That word is reserved for stopping, starting, help or replies. Pick another.
smsKeywordProblem.duplicate: Another queue already uses that word.

provider.label: Whose line is this?
provider.hint: Bookings on this line go only to this person. Anyone means whoever is free.
provider.failed: Couldn't save. They must work at this location, and you need manager access.

devices.title: Screens
devices.adminsOnly: Only admins and owners can pair and manage screens.

pair.title: Pair a screen
pair.name: Name
pair.enterOn: On the screen, open {{url}} and enter this code:
pair.expired: This code has expired. Create a new one.
pair.paired: Paired. The screen is in the list below.

revoke.title: Revoke {{name}}?
revoke.description: Within a minute the screen goes back to its pairing screen. To use it again, pair it with a new code.

errors.rate_limited: You have 10 unused codes. Use one or wait 10 minutes for them to expire.
errors.invalid_input: Use a name of 80 characters or fewer.
errors.not_found: Only admins and owners can pair screens.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.

services.title: Services in {{queue}}
services.emptyHint: Without services, customers just join the queue. Add some if they should pick what they need.
services.name: Service name
services.ticketPrefixHint: 1 to 3 capital letters. Leave empty to use the queue's "{{queue}}". Tickets will look like {{example}}.
services.activeHint: Turn off to stop offering it. Past visits keep it.
services.servedByHint: Which chairs, rooms or people can do this? Leave all unticked and anyone can.

intake.title: Intake questions for {{queue}}
intake.intro: What customers are asked when they join. Keep it short: every question slows the line.
intake.emptyHint: Customers give a name and, if they like, a phone number.
intake.label: Question
intake.helpHint: A short line under the question.
intake.optionsHint: One per line, up to 50, no repeats.
intake.optionsInvalid: Give at least one choice, and no repeats.
intake.visibilityStaff: Staff only (filled in at the desk)
intake.previewHint: Try it. Nothing here is saved.
intake.healthTerm: This looks like it asks for health information ("{{term}}"). Only ask what you need, tell customers why, and check the rules that apply to you before collecting it.
intake.healthOrgText: This business is marked as a health provider. Free-text answers can contain medical details, so prefer a list of choices, and check the rules that apply to you.

counters.title: Resources
counters.intro: The chairs, desks, rooms, tables or people customers are sent to when called. The screen shows "A012 → Chair 2".
counters.emptyHint: Without resources, called customers are sent to the front desk.
counters.label: Resource name
counters.labelHint: Short, as customers will see it: "Chair 2", "Room 4".
counters.archiveDescription: Staff can no longer send customers here. Past calls keep the name.

poster.title: Join poster
poster.hint: Print it on A4 or Letter and put it up where people arrive.
poster.headline: Scan to join the line
poster.step1: 1. Open your phone camera and point it at the code.
poster.step2: 2. Enter your first name and tap Join.
poster.step3: 3. Wait anywhere: the page shows your place and tells you when it's your turn.

signage.title: Signage
signage.intro: Slides your waiting-room TV shows between calls. Calls always stay on screen.
signage.readOnly: Only owners and admins can change signage.
signage.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Check the times and try again.
signage.removeBody: It leaves the TV rotation at once.
signage.imageType: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image. SVG files aren't accepted.
signage.imageFailed: Couldn't upload that image. Try a different one.

branding.title: Branding
branding.intro: What guests see on your join and status pages.
branding.readOnly: Only owners and admins can change branding.
branding.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Check the colours and links, then try again.
branding.https: Use a link that starts with https://

image.type: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image. SVG files aren't accepted.
image.failed: Couldn't upload that image. Try a different one.

colour.low: White text is hard to read on this colour, so guest pages will use {{text}} text on it.

hideProduct.label: Hide the product name
hideProduct.hint: Removes “Powered by” from guest pages, displays and emails. A small “Source code” link always stays, as the open-source licence requires.
hideProduct.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change this. A “Source code” link always stays.
hideProduct.failed: Couldn't change this setting. Try again.

analytics.badRange: The start date must be on or before the end date.

booking.title: Booking for {{service}}
booking.readOnly: You can view these settings but not change them.
booking.bookable: Guests can book this service online
booking.bookableHint: Off hides it from the public booking page.
booking.durationHint: Leave empty to use the service's expected minutes.
booking.maxDaysAhead: Book up to this many days ahead

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.hint: Seats per slot, or bookings per day. A specific date beats a weekday, which beats the default.
capacity.empty: No rules. One booking per slot.
capacity.removeBody: The default applies to that day again.
capacity.duplicate: A rule for that already exists. Remove it first.

preview.title: Next 7 days
preview.hint: What guests would be offered now.

errors.permission_denied: You don't have permission to change booking settings.

deletionBanner.message: This business and all its data will be erased on {{when}}. Everyone is locked out until then.

export.readOnly: Only owners and admins can export data.
export.hint: Download everything your organization has stored: locations, queues, visits, guests, messages and the audit log. Guest contact details are included, so keep the file safe.
export.jsonl: JSON Lines files in a zip
export.limit: Up to 3 exports a day for the organization.

error.rate_limited: The organization has used its 3 exports for today. Try again tomorrow.
error.mfa_required: Confirm your sign-in with your authenticator app first.
error.permission_denied: Only owners and admins can export data.

availability.title: Staff availability
availability.readOnly: You can view availability but not change it.
availability.overlap: Those hours overlap hours already set for that day. Change or remove the other range first.
availability.removeBody: Guests may be offered or refused different times afterwards.
availability.exceptionNeedsTimes: Extra hours need a start and an end.

errors.permission_denied: You don't have permission to change availability.

widget.title: Website widget
widget.hint: Paste this line into your website where you want the join form to appear. Guests join without leaving your site.

priority.title: Priority
priority.intro: Let some guests move ahead of the line, for example guests who need accessibility support. Guests never choose their own priority.
priority.emptyHint: Add a class, then give it to guests from the console or with a rule.
priority.offset_one: Moves ahead of guests who joined up to {{count}} minute earlier
priority.offset_other: Moves ahead of guests who joined up to {{count}} minutes earlier
priority.dragNote: Moving a guest by hand in the console overrides their priority.
priority.rulesIntro: Rules give a class automatically when a guest joins. The lowest rank number that matches wins.
priority.name: Class name
priority.offsetHint: 0 to 720. The guest is placed as if they had joined this many minutes earlier.
priority.colorHint: Shown with the class name; the name always appears too.
priority.conditionSource: The guest joins in a particular way
priority.conditionAnswer: The guest gives a particular answer
priority.question: Question
priority.answerHint: Must match the answer exactly, as it appears in the question.

routing.title: Routing
routing.intro: When a guest joins the location without picking a queue, the first active rule that fits decides which queue they join. If none fits, they are told to ask at the desk.
routing.emptyHint: Without rules, guests pick a queue themselves.
routing.order: Rules are checked from the top. Move a rule up to make it win.
routing.question: Also when the guest answers
routing.questionHint: Optional. Only questions on the target queue's form can be used.

singleActive.title: One ticket at a time
singleActive.explain: Stop the same phone, email or device from holding more than one place in line at once. Staff can still add anyone.
singleActive.label: Rule

hint.off: Guests can join as many queues as they like.
hint.location: A guest waiting at a location cannot join another queue there until they leave.
hint.org: A guest waiting anywhere cannot join any queue until they leave.

singleActive.readOnly: Only admins and owners can change this.

gbp.title: Google Business Profile
gbp.hint: Put your join link on your Google listing so people can join the line from Google Search and Maps.
gbp.step1: Open your Business Profile on Google (search for your business while signed in, or use business.google.com).
gbp.step2: Choose Edit profile, then Booking links (or Appointment link).
gbp.step3: Paste the link above and save.
gbp.step4: Google can take a few days to show it. Open the link on your phone to check that it works.
gbp.limits: Google's own "join waitlist" button needs Google's partner approval, which isn't available to us. This link shows as a booking or appointment button instead. People who join through it are counted as coming from Google.
